USAGE:
    mempalacenet [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    mempalacenet mempalacenet init ./my-palace
    mempalacenet mempalacenet init ./my-palace --name "My Palace"
    mempalacenet mempalacenet mine ./project --mode files
    mempalacenet mempalacenet mine ~/.claude/projects --mode convos --wing 
conversations
    mempalacenet mempalacenet search "vector databases"

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    init <path>       Initialize a new palace                  
    mine <path>       Mine memories from files or conversations
    search <query>    Search for memories                      
    wake-up           Load context summary for new session     
    mcp               Start MCP server (Model Context Protocol)
    agents            Agent management commands                
    kg                Knowledge graph operations

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Search for memories

USAGE:
    mempalacenet search <query> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    mempalacenet mempalacenet search "vector databases"
    mempalacenet mempalacenet search "CLI design" --wing code --rerank --top-k 5

ARGUMENTS:
    <query>    Search query

OPTIONS:
                        DEFAULT                                                 
    -h, --help                      Prints help information                     
        --wing                      Limit search to a specific wing             
        --rerank                    Enable LLM-based reranking                  
        --bm25                      Enable BM25 keyword-only search (instead of 
                                    semantic)                                   
        --hybrid                    Enable hybrid search (semantic + keyword via
                                    RRF)                                        
        --top-k         10          Number of results to return                 
        --collection    memories    Collection name                             
        --verbose                   Enable verbose output
